plans.name: Single Hotel
plans.for: A dashboard for your hotel: visibility, competitors, tracked actions and progress over time.
features: Your hotel dashboard: what AI says about it, who gets named instead, and what to fix first
Action tracking: see what you have done and what is still open
Competitor intelligence: which comparable hotels are named, and the pages the assistant cited
Website and external-presence analysis, with the evidence behind each finding
Prioritised recommendations, ranked by risk and effort
Progress over time, so you can see what moved
Your own questions tested, and your review export analysed
Pull a report from your dashboard whenever you need one

plans.name: Portfolio
plans.for: For groups: everything in Single Hotel, with access to every hotel and analytics to see how each one is doing, priced per hotel.
features: Everything in Single Hotel, for every hotel
One login for every hotel, with each hotel's score, trends and AI visibility side by side
Analytics on how each hotel is doing: which need attention, and which are improving
Actions tracked hotel by hotel: how many are done, and how many are still open

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.for: For 50 or more hotels, with a tailored quotation.
features: Options available for discussion: portfolio-wide analytics, centralised dashboards, cross-property benchmarking, consolidated billing, custom analytics, additional account support and tailored implementation arrangements

founding.headline: Join early. Pay half price for your first year.
founding.message: Early joiners get the complete Presence Pro platform for £49.99 a month for their first 12 months, instead of £99. In return, you help shape what we build next.
benefits: The complete platform, with a dashboard for your hotel
A monthly GEO assessment of your hotel
AI recommendation visibility, sampled each month
Competitor intelligence: who is named instead of you, and why
Prioritised recommendations, ranked by risk and effort
Historical performance tracking, building up month by month from your first check
£49.99 a month for your first 12 months, instead of £99
asks: Occasional feedback on the dashboard and the platform
Help us understand which recommendations you find most useful
Permission to use your results, anonymised, to improve the platform
